[P2] Compare against scanned partition locations

The SDK's `buildCreateTableDdl` projects partitions under `<root>/year=.../month=.../day=...`. Results written to `<root>/athena-results/` are outside those partitions, but this comparison reports `inside`. Consequently, `testAthena` skips its probe and returns `ok: false` for a valid configuration; this is more than an extra warning. Determine overlap using the actual partition locations or projection template before reporting that results add rows and failing the connection test.
